source_name: Banka Slovenije — katalog informacij javnega značaja & publikacije
why_relevant: The central bank is itself a contracting authority; its FOI catalogue states that all procurement documentation is published on enarocanje.si, which pins the route for tracking central-bank IT, cash-handling and payment-system purchases. The publications and release-calendar pages also anchor payment-systems reporting (Žiro kliring, TARGET/STEP2 participation).

source_name: Banka Slovenije - EEA passported payment institutions and e-money institutions operating in Slovenia
why_relevant: Lists foreign EEA payment and e-money institutions passported into Slovenia - the competitive layer that never appears in domestic company registers. Essential for a true payments market map.

source_name: Banka Slovenije - Predvideni datumi objav publikacij (release calendar)
why_relevant: Advance release calendar lets the collector schedule polling precisely around statistical and report releases instead of blind daily crawling; also enumerates the full publication set.

source_name: NLB Analyst Coverage page (sell-side broker list)
why_relevant: Names the ~10 sell-side houses covering NLB. This is the actor map for the analyst layer - each named broker becomes a downstream source lead for research notes, conference invitations and sector commentary on Slovenian banking.

source_name: NLB Group investor relations contact desk (IR@nlb.si, Head of IR)
why_relevant: Named IR contact channel. Useful for resolving document ambiguity or requesting historical decks; also a stable indicator of IR-team continuity. Contact only through official channels and for legitimate research requests.

source_name: Združenje bank Slovenije (ZBS) — annual report and member directory
why_relevant: The banking association's annual report enumerates member banks and carries sector-level macro and banking indicators; the membership list is the cleanest single actor map for this cell (it names every bank and savings bank in scope plus adjacent ones like Hranilnica Lon and Primorska hranilnica Vipava).

source_name: ZBS – Članice (member directory of banks, savings banks and leasing companies)
why_relevant: Enumerates the population of Slovenian banks/savings banks (~15) and leasing companies (~12) — the seed list for all issuer-level A1 disclosure collection. Observed on fetch: members rendered as logos, apparently without per-member hyperlinks, so names may need OCR/alt-text extraction.

source_name: OPSI publisher page — Ministrstvo za finance / UJP datasets
why_relevant: Enumerates the machine-readable datasets published by the Ministry of Finance/UJP — the fastest way to discover structured public-payment and budget-user data (e-invoices, sub-accounts, payment flows) instead of guessing at endpoints.

source_name: e-uprava institution directory (registry of public-sector contracting authorities)
why_relevant: Directory of Slovenian public institutions with identifiers and contact/organisational detail; used to enumerate the full list of public-sector 'naročniki' in the finance domain so no contracting authority in the cell is missed.

source_name: AJPES ePRS – Poslovni register Slovenije (Business Register search, incl. by SKD activity)
why_relevant: Central register of all Slovenian legal entities; basic search supports filtering by SKD (NACE) main activity code and institutional sector, which is exactly how one enumerates the banking (64.19), holding/other financial (64/65/66.19) and payment-services universe before pulling their filings.

source_name: AJPES – Koledar javne objave letnih poročil (disclosure calendar)
why_relevant: Publishes the dates on which each tranche of annual reports becomes public (e.g. mass disclosure for FY2025 reported in early August 2026). Lets a collector schedule crawls instead of polling blindly.

source_name: ATVP (Agencija za trg vrednostnih papirjev) - Nadzorovani subjekti: javne družbe
why_relevant: List of Slovenian public companies (issuers) subject to periodic disclosure - includes the listed banks and insurers whose annual/half-year reports and IR flow are the A1 target. Companion page lists investment-service providers.

source_name: Ljubljana Stock Exchange – List of Issuers
why_relevant: Authoritative roster of every issuer on the exchange market with links to their regulated information — the seed list for which Slovenian financial-sector companies have continuous disclosure obligations at all.

source_name: GZS – Združenje za informatiko in telekomunikacije (ZIT)
why_relevant: The ICT branch association inside GZS — its membership page and management board list identify Slovenian IT/telecom firms, several of which are bank/payment technology suppliers; the board composition itself maps the vendor hierarchy.

source_name: GZS – Register članov GZS (chamber member register)
why_relevant: A member register at chamber level is a searchable enumeration of Slovenian companies by activity — usable to identify payment/IT vendors and financial-sector suppliers beyond the bank list.

source_name: AZN - Register zastopnikov in posrednikov + Stališča in obvestila agencije
why_relevant: Public register of insurance agents/brokers plus the agency's positions and notices - actor map for the distribution layer (including bank-owned agencies) and running supervisory-opinion feed.

source_name: IP-RS – Katalog informacij javnega značaja (FOI catalogue; route to unpublished inspection decisions)
why_relevant: Inspection decisions (inšpekcijske odločbe) are reportedly NOT routinely published due to sensitivity, but are among the most-requested FOI items. This catalogue is the documented route to request specific decisions naming banks/PSPs.

source_name: Informacijski pooblaščenec (IPRS) - decisions on FOI appeals against Banka Slovenije
why_relevant: The Information Commissioner's decision search reveals what supervisory information BS and other regulators have withheld or been ordered to release - a route to non-published documents and a map of confidentiality boundaries.

source_name: Bizi.si / EBONITETE.SI / CompanyWall — Slovenian commercial company-data aggregators
why_relevant: Fast way to resolve entity identity, name history and parent structure for SI payment companies — these aggregators surfaced the full Nexi Slovenija rename chain (Nets CEE -> Mercury Processing -> Intesa Sanpaolo Card -> Nexi) and headline financials.

source_name: Bizi.si and Računalniške novice event listings (Slovenian business/ICT event aggregators)
why_relevant: Aggregator listings of Slovenian business and ICT events (e.g. the 43rd Finančna konferenca on bizi.si, DFK on racunalniske-novice.com). Cheap discovery layer for new or one-off banking/payments events that never surface in association calendars.

source_name: HRC d.o.o. — O nas (reference customer list)
why_relevant: Explicit named customer roster of Slovenian financial institutions: Addiko Bank, BKS Bank AG, Delavska hranilnica, LON, Primorska hranilnica Vipava, RCI Banque, NLB, Gorenjska banka, Deželna banka Slovenije, OTP banka, Slovenski državni holding. Directly maps vendor-to-bank relationships that never appear in procurement records.

source_name: SID banka — Informacije javnega značaja / katalog
why_relevant: ZDIJZ catalogue page — points to the bank's obligatory disclosures, contract/business transparency registers and the FOI request route. Pointer to documents not otherwise indexed, and the legal basis for requesting procurement detail.

source_name: SKB banka d.d. — annual reports / press (legacy, merged into OTP banka)
why_relevant: SKB was deleted from the Bank of Slovenia supervised register on 22.8.2024 after merging into OTP; the legacy PDF archive (letno poročilo 2008–2023) remains the historical baseline for SKB's pre-merger tech and cost base.

source_name: Wikipedia — List of newspapers in Slovenia / Finance (časopis)
why_relevant: Cheap actor-map bootstrap for the Slovenian press landscape: names publishers, ownership (e.g. Finance owned by Sweden's Bonnier Group, also publishing Manager and Moje finance) and titles beyond the seed list, enabling systematic snowballing to regional and specialist outlets not yet covered.

source_name: ZPS – Kam se obrniti, ko so kratene pravice potrošnikom (map of supervisory institutions)
why_relevant: Pointer page enumerating Slovenian supervisory/complaint bodies (TIRS, BSi, AZN, ATVP, IP-RS, ministries) — an actor map for the whole complaint-channel cell, useful for snowballing further sources.

source_name: Akademija Finance – conference portfolio (incl. Poslovna konferenca Portorož)
why_relevant: Commercial organiser behind many Slovenian finance/business conferences since 1999. Its conference index is a compact pointer to dated events, agendas and speaker rosters across finance, tax and business, several of which feature bankers.

source_name: Bitcoin Društvo Slovenije (bitcoin.si)
why_relevant: Community association maintaining Slovenian-language crypto resources and, historically, merchant-acceptance listings; useful for local terminology and for finding merchants/venues accepting crypto that never issue press releases.

source_name: Blockchain Alliance Europe (blockchainalliance.si) – membership directory and publications
why_relevant: Ljubljana-based industry association whose member list is effectively a curated roster of Slovenian blockchain/crypto-payments companies — a strong snowballing pointer for actors outside the well-known trio, plus policy-position content.

source_name: Careerjet.si - job aggregator with per-company pages
why_relevant: Aggregates across SI boards and employer sites, so it catches ads that only ever lived on a bank's own careers page; per-company and per-sector URLs (NLB Group, OTP Banka, bančništvo Ljubljana) make it a good discovery layer for new actors.

source_name: Comtrade System Integration — Banking & Finances vertical page
why_relevant: Comtrade SI (Ljubljana office, part of Comtrade Group) publishes banking-vertical customer stories; search results indicate a named Nova KBM engagement (Software Asset Management programme). The banking vertical page is the entry point to their bank case studies in the region.

source_name: e-Justice portal – Slovenia business registers page (BRIS entry point)
why_relevant: EU-level description of and gateway to the Slovenian register, including the BRIS interconnection. Useful for cross-border lookups of Slovenian entities and for confirming which register is legally authoritative for which document type.

source_name: EURES Slovenia - living and working conditions / EU vacancy network
why_relevant: EU-level vacancy network fed by ZRSZ; useful as a machine-readable cross-border mirror of Slovenian vacancies and for spotting SI banks/fintechs recruiting abroad (a scale-up signal).

source_name: FIN-NET (European Commission) – financial dispute resolution network member listing for Slovenia
why_relevant: EU-level authoritative registry of national financial ADR bodies; confirms which Slovenian bodies are recognised for banking/payment disputes and provides an EN-language cross-check for the ADR actor map.

source_name: Mikrografija d.o.o. — References page (mDocs, mSign)
why_relevant: Named financial-sector reference: Delavska hranilnica d.d. using mDocs and mSign (document management / e-signature) with a named contact testimonial. Confirms a document/e-signature vendor inside a Slovenian bank. Testimonials only, no deep case studies.

source_name: PISRS — Zakon o javnem naročanju (ZJN-3) and Zakon o plačilnih storitvah in sistemih
why_relevant: The legal register defines what must be published, when, and how contract value is computed for banking and financial services (fees, commissions, interest) — essential for interpreting award values correctly and for knowing which thresholds push a notice to TED. Also anchors the payment-services legal vocabulary.

source_name: SBCA – Slovenian Blockchain Association
why_relevant: Second Slovenian blockchain industry body; complements Blockchain Alliance Europe for actor discovery and for identifying who speaks for the crypto-payments segment in consultations.

source_name: Slovenska digitalna koalicija (digitalna.si)
why_relevant: Multi-stakeholder coordination forum for Slovenia's digital transformation (e-commerce, e-skills, cybersecurity, digitisation of the private sector). Its partner/coalition membership and project pages link public bodies with banks, telcos and ICT vendors.

source_name: Slovensko društvo INFORMATIKA – events listing
why_relevant: Organiser hub for DSI and related ICT events; announces calls for papers and partner/sponsor lists, which reveal which technology vendors are courting Slovenian banks.

source_name: Slovensko zavarovalno združenje (Slovenian Insurance Association) – members
why_relevant: Insurance is the adjacent financial vertical (bancassurance, payment-linked products); the association's ~25-member list enumerates SI insurers and its statute/reports mirror ZBS's role for that sector.

source_name: Sodišče RS – Iskalnik sodne prakse (sodisce.si knowledge/case-law portal)
why_relevant: Judiciary's own portal into court decisions and court-level structure; useful pointer to per-court case databases and to Vrhovno sodišče decisions on banking disputes.

source_name: Startup Slovenija (startup.si) – Startup mapa: startupi & scaleupi, investitorji, novice
why_relevant: Official-ecosystem directory of Slovenian startups/scaleups with per-company profiles (Paywiser is listed) plus an investment-tagged news stream. Best single pointer for discovering wallet/BNPL/payment startups that never appear in licence registers.
